subject: Klausimas dėl bendradarbiavimo su Baltic Horizon Partners
body:
Hello,

We are a direct manufacturer of premium fiberglass & ThermoWood hot tubs handcrafted in Lithuania.

Our wood-fired hot tubs with integrated stainless-steel heaters are engineered specifically for high-end glamping resorts, boutique rentals, and spa dealers looking for superior Scandinavian build quality at direct-from-factory pricing.

Why partner with us?
• Direct manufacturer pricing (35%+ margins for partners/dealers)
• Fully CE certified with 2-year comprehensive European warranty
• Doorstep delivery across Europe (single units or full truckloads)

Would you like us to email you our 2026 B2B catalogue with wholesale pricing and delivery estimates?

Best regards,
Klaus Bergmann | Export Sales Manager
